note: Valley City Parks and Recreation campground on the east end of town beside the Rainbow Bridge over the Sheyenne River; shady, and a walk from downtown. Sites 1-10 are 30-amp, sites 11-27 50-amp. --Claude
summary: Valley City Parks and Recreation page + map: 27 full-hookup sites (1-10 30 A, 11-27 50 A), per-site lengths (shortest 24 ft), showers/restrooms, open mid-May to mid-October, $35 daily / $250 weekly / $650 monthly, booked on Campspot. All stored derived values confirmed; fees, sites note, booking url/platform added. Not waterfront stands. Pin ok. Website -> vcparks.com.
flags: WEBSITE: old https://www.valleycitytourism.com/lodging-camping -> new https://www.vcparks.com/touristparkcampground (Valley City Parks and Recreation's own page).
PHONE: stored 701-845-3294 matches the VCPR page: ok.
FIT: every site takes 23 ft (shortest posting 'up to 24 feet', sites 4, 5, 8, 9, 10). No max_rig_ft written (most sites 'unlimited length').

LONG-STAY: weekly and monthly reservations are sold alongside daily; no wording discouraging nightly guests. Campspot (where occupancy would show) not read. Google 'Municipal Tourist Park' 3.9 from 67 (a local park, so the private under-4 rule does not apply; reported for the record).

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. The sites line the north side of East Main Street west of the Rainbow Bridge; the Sheyenne (~40-45 m wide here) is ~60 m+ east of the easternmost RVs behind a wooded bank.
